title: Service Contracts: can the customer end its contract early, and what follows?
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs early termination of a contract by the customer: who may give notice, from which date early termination is possible, when it takes effect, how the term is then assessed for shortfall, and what happens to unsettled rebate.

## Formal clauses
1. Only the customer can terminate its contract early, by signed notice.
2. Early termination is possible only once the tier's minimum run, in calendar months of the term, has run from the effective date.
3. The earliest date falls on the same day of the month that many months after the effective date, or on the last day of that month when it has no such day.
4. The termination takes effect the tier's notice period, in calendar days, after the notice.
5. The term is then assessed for shortfall on the tier's early termination basis: against the full minimum quantity commitment under the full term basis, or, under the prorated to termination basis, against the commitment prorated by the calendar days run over the calendar days of the whole term.
6. Unsettled rebate is settled at termination.

Early termination moves an active contract to terminated.

## The time test at a glance
| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Date the months are counted from | the effective date on the line's record of the contract |
| Unit | calendar months, the tier's minimum run |
| Earliest date | the same day of the month that many months later, or the last day of that month when it has no such day |
| Comparison | early termination may not be handled before the earliest date |
| On the earliest date itself | early termination is possible |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 5-month minimum run, for illustration only)
| Effective date | Earliest date | Possible | Not yet possible |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-31 | 2027-01-31 | on 2027-01-31 | on 2027-01-30 |
| 2026-09-30 | 2027-02-28, because February 2027 has no 30th day | on 2027-02-28 | on 2027-02-27 |

## When it takes effect (hypothetical 45-day notice period)
Signed notice given on 2026-06-10 takes effect 45 calendar days later, on 2026-07-25.

## Shortfall commitment on early termination (hypothetical: commitment 1000 FEU, 146 of the term's 365 calendar days run)
| Basis | Commitment assessed |
|---|---|
| full term | the full 1000 FEU |
| prorated to termination | 1000 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365, that is 400 FEU |

## Points of judgement
**May the line end a contract early on the customer's behalf?** No. Only the customer can terminate early, and only by signed notice.

**What happens to rebate accrued but not yet settled?** It is settled at termination.
